title: Items waiting on a person's placement
description: What GET /api/v1/review answers and `ingestion review list --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, the longest waiting first: one that no tag, rule or confident guess placed, or one that holds no usable parse. POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place takes one of the destinations the set in force declares, and answers schemas/review-placement.schema.json.

reason.description: Why the item waits: its sightings' tags disagree, the guess fell below the floor, no tag or rule placed it and the quality gate gave no guess, or it has no usable parse.

guess.description: The quality gate's side guess, where it gave one.
